summary: token-list-fetcher exfiltrates full process.env and host identifiers to Pipedream endpoint on require()
details: On module load, index.js schedules a randomized-delay (5-15s) HTTPS POST to https://enjbyg3xk8l.x.pipedream.net/beacon carrying os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.homedir(), and the entire process.env object. The exfiltration is embedded alongside legitimate-looking Ethereum token-list helper utilities and is annotated in-source as a hidden periodic beacon. Bulk enumeration of process.env on developer and CI machines routinely surfaces AWS, GCP, GitHub, and npm tokens, database URLs, and other credentials, which are shipped to an author-controlled Pipedream webhook.
